Hi Daniel — great, thanks for sending the docs. We should be able to get you live quickly. For Redwood's vendor master we need the following canonical fields filled:

• Legal entity name (as on tax docs)
• DBA (if different)
• Tax ID / EIN
• Company type (Corp / LLC / Sole Prop / Other)
• Registered address (street, city, state/province, country, postal code)
• Remittance address (if different)
• Primary AP contact (name, role, email, phone) — this is the person we route POs and payment questions to
• Banking details for ACH / wire (bank name, account holder, routing/IBAN, SWIFT)
• Invoice remit instructions and preferred invoice metadata (PO number field name, required line item codes)

Our typical commercial terms are net 45 by default for new suppliers; Procurement can agree alternatives for strategic partners. PO format: please include the PO number on the invoice header and in the filename (e.g., PO-12345_Solstice_Invoice.pdf).

I've attached our vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx — if you can populate that and return it, Procurement will ingest and Karthik will create the master record.

Also looping Karthik Iyer (AP/ERP) here to confirm any ERP-specific fields we should capture up front.

Thanks —
